name: validate_user_pin
discountpercentage
script:
if doc.is_pos:
    if not doc.apply_discount_on:
        doc.apply_discount_on = "Grand Total"

    if doc.discount_amount:
        # 1. Round discount amount to a whole number (e.g., 100)
        rounded_discount = int(round(float(doc.discount_amount or 0)))
        doc.discount_amount = rounded_discount

        # 2. Compute discount percentage rounded to 2 decimal places (e.g., 11.11)
        gross_total = sum([float(item.amount or (item.rate * item.qty)) for item in doc.items])
        if gross_total > 0:
            doc.additional_discount_percentage = round((rounded_discount / gross_total) * 100, 2)

        # 3. Explicitly override totals to keep receipt calculations exact
        final_total = round(gross_total - rounded_discount, 2)
        doc.net_total = final_total
        doc.grand_total = final_total
        doc.rounded_total = final_total
        doc.base_grand_total = final_total
        doc.paid_amount = final_total

        # 4. Sync payment lines
        if doc.payments:
            for payment in doc.payments:
                payment.amount = final_total
                payment.base_amount = final_total
